title: Experimental Jetset
summary: A design studio in Amsterdam since 1997. It treats graphic design as a system of language, print, typography and cultural reference.

hero_image.alt: A paper guillotine at the edge of a worktable spread with printed sheets, colour swatches, a loupe and a steel rule.
hero_image.caption: Print checked at actual size: the medium itself is the constraint the work is built from.
